objective: Determine whether the frozen absolute endpoint relies on box/conflict geometry, pair topology, or mostly score/class set statistics without rereading outer.
decision_rule: If both all-geometry and pair-branch ablations exceed both degradation gates, the original feature control was underpowered and a fresh control design is warranted. Otherwise freeze geometry-conditioned endpoint claims and retain only a narrower detector score/set-statistics observation.
claim_boundary: Researcher-adaptive fit/tune artifact attribution. No retraining, new images, outer cache, detector validation, AP, or endpoint-validation claim.
